original_query: Which country had the higher percentage of Tablet Pageviews in June 2014, Russia or the country where 61 million euros was spent in online display ads in 2013?

summaries.found_via_query: Country that spent 61 million euros in online display ads in 2013 and Tablet Pageviews percentage in June 2014 vs Russia
summaries.summary: The slide presents mobile pageviews by country in June 2014, comparing PC, Phone, and Tablet usage. It includes data for countries like Croatia, Lithuania, Serbia, and Russia, with Russia showing 5% Tablet pageviews. The source is gemiusRanking, June 2014, and the slide was presented at an IAA Mobile Awareness session on April 25, 2015.

summaries.found_via_query: Country that spent 61 million euros in online display ads in 2013
summaries.summary: The slide presents data on mobile display ad spend and YoY growth for several European countries in 2013, including Turkey, Czech Republic, Hungary, Poland, Slovenia, Serbia, Romania, Bulgaria, and Croatia. Hungary spent 61 million euros in online display ads in 2013. The data also includes the percentage of mobile display ads as a share of total online display ads for each country, with Romania having the highest percentage at 0.7% (marked with a trophy icon). The source is IAB Europe AdEx Benchmark 2013, presented at an IAA Mobile Awareness session on April 25, 2015.
key_facts: Hungary spent 61 million euros in online display ads in 2013.
Romania had the highest mobile display ad share at 0.7% (marked with a trophy icon).
Source: IAB Europe AdEx Benchmark 2013.
Presentation date: April 25, 2015.
visible_text: Mobile display as a share of total online display (%)
